title: Trouble No. 4     No up-shift to overdrive (After warm-up)

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for troubleshooting no up-shift to overdrive condition after warm-up in automatic transmission with electric control
labels: Road test while shifting manually with ECT ECU connector pulled out. Is there overdrive up-shift in D range when shifting from L to 2 to D?
Connect ECT ECU connector, and while driving does OG terminal voltage rise from OV to 7V in sequence?
There is 12V between ECT ECU terminals 2 and GND when D range.
There is 12V between ECT ECU terminals L and GND when D range.

• Faulty neutral start switch circuit
• Faulty neutral start switch

Is voltage between terminals OD₃ and GND as follows?
OD switch turn ON:   12V (Aisin) or 5V (Denso)
OD switch turn OFF:  OV

• Faulty OD switch harness
• Faulty OD switch
• OD off light open

Is voltage between terminals OD and GND as follows?
Approx.    5V (Denso) or 12V (Aisin)
(coolant temp. above 70°C or 158°F)
Is voltage between ECU terminals OD₁ and GND normal with the cruise control computer connector pulled out?

Faulty engine ECU
(Short circuit in ECT wire harness
or EFI water temp. sensor bad)
